description: Legal Affairs Department - Regulation of Insurance Industry Act No. 43 of 2000
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000, specifically amending previous insurance regulations. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - amending and repealing specific regulations and schedules related to insurance industry oversight, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
